== Summary ==
Slip “•Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 52, 581, 775)). Version [[Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus|Welcome Home, Lord Tyranus (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
